idea-plugin.name: Selvage
idea-plugin.description:
Selvage lets people edit the same project at the same time, each from their own editor. You host a session from the project you have open and send the invite link it gives you. The other person joins from that link, and from then on you both type into the same files, see each other's carets and selections, and can go to or follow another participant.

File contents and edits travel through the Selvage server you choose, which relays them between the participants. They are sealed end to end under a key that is carried in the invite link's fragment and never sent to the server, so the server cannot read the files, the edits, the carets or the list of shared files. When you host, the plugin asks which server to use and offers the public demo server; you can run your own selvaged and use that instead. A guest uses the server named in the invite link.

A guest gets a local copy of the files the host shares, opened as a new project window in safe mode, so code insight works on ordinary files. The copy is removed when the session ends. A host shares the project's folder minus dependency and build directories, secret files such as .env and private keys, and whatever the folder's ignore files leave out.

Sessions work across the Selvage clients for VS Code, Neovim and the browser.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0, the first release.

  • Host a session from the open project, or join one from an invite link.
  • Shared editing with the other participants' carets, selections and project view badges.
  • Open or fetch a document from the room, list the people in it, and go to or follow one of them.
  • The same twelve commands as the VS Code client, under Tools | Selvage.
